description: Ocean drift model configuration for OpenDrift.

lon.description: Central longitude for seeding drifters. Only used if `seed_flag=="elements"`.
lon.title: Lon

lat.description: Central latitude for seeding drifters. Only used if `seed_flag=="elements"`.
lat.title: Lat

geojson.description: GeoJSON describing a polygon within which to seed drifters. To use this parameter, also have `seed_flag=="geojson"`.
geojson.title: Geojson

seed_flag.description: Method for seeding drifters. Options are "elements" or "geojson". If "elements", seed drifters at or around a single point defined by lon and lat. If "geojson", seed drifters within a polygon described by a GeoJSON object.

start_time.description: Start time for drifter simulation. start_time or end_time must be input.
start_time.title: Start Time

start_time_end.description: If used, this creates a range of start times for drifters, starting with `start_time` and ending with `start_time_end`. Drifters will be initialized linearly between the two start times.
start_time_end.title: Start Time End

time_step.description: Interval between particles updates, in seconds.
time_step.title: Time Step

time_step_output.description: Time step at which element properties are stored and eventually written to file. This must be larger than the calculation time step, and be an integer multiple of this.
time_step_output.title: Time Step Output

steps.description: Maximum number of steps. End of simulation will be start_time + steps * time_step.
steps.title: Steps

duration.description: Duration should be input as a string of ISO 8601. The length of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.
duration.title: Duration

end_time.description: The end of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user. start_time or end_time must be input.
end_time.title: End Time

ocean_model.description: Name of ocean model to use for driving drifter simulation.

do3D.description: Set to True to run drifters in 3D, by default False for most drift models.
do3D.title: Do3D

horizontal_diffusivity.description: Add horizontal diffusivity (random walk). For known ocean models, the value is calculated as the approximate horizontal grid resolution for the selected ocean model times an estimate of the scale of sub-gridscale velocity of 0.1 m/s.
horizontal_diffusivity.title: Horizontal Diffusivity

stokes_drift.description: Advection elements with Stokes drift (wave orbital motion).
stokes_drift.title: Stokes Drift

z.description: Depth below sea level where elements are released. This depth is neglected if seafloor seeding is set selected.
z.title: Z

number.description: The number of elements for the simulation.
number.title: Number

export_variables.description: List of variables to export. Options available with `m.all_export_variables` for a given `drift_model`. [***REMOVED***lon***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***lat***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***ID***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***status***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***z***REMOVED***] will always be exported. Default of None means all possible variables are exported.
export_variables.title: Export Variables

plots.description: Dictionary of plots to generate using OpenDrift.
plots.title: Plots

radius.description: Radius around each lon-lat pair, within which particles will be seeded according to `radius_type`.
radius.title: Radius

radius_type.description: Distribution for seeding particles around location. Options: ***REMOVED***gaussian***REMOVED*** or ***REMOVED***uniform***REMOVED***.

max_speed.description: Typical maximum speed of elements, used to estimate reader buffer size
max_speed.title: Maximum speed

coastline_action.description: This controls particle behavior at the coastline. Use `previous` for a particle to move back to its previous location if it hits land. Use `stranding` to have a particle stick (that is, become deactivated) where it interacts with land. With None, objects may also move over land.
coastline_action.title: Coastline Action

current_uncertainty.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to current components at each time step
current_uncertainty.title: Current Uncertainty

wind_uncertainty.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to wind components at each time step.
wind_uncertainty.title: Wind Uncertainty

seed_seafloor.description: Elements are seeded at seafloor, and seeding depth (z) is neglected and must be None.
seed_seafloor.title: Seed Seafloor

diffusivitymodel.description: Algorithm/source used for profile of vertical diffusivity. Environment means that diffusivity is acquired from readers or environment constants/fallback. Parameterizations based on wind speed are also available.
diffusivitymodel.title: Diffusivity model

mixed_layer_depth.description: mixed_layer_depth controls how deep the vertical diffusivity profile reaches. This sets the fallback value for ocean_mixed_layer_thickness if not available from any reader.
mixed_layer_depth.title: Mixed Layer Depth

seafloor_action.description: This controls particle behavior at the seafloor. Use `deactivate` to stick particles to the seafloor at the point of interaction. Use `lift_to_seafloor` to elevate particles up to seabed if below. User `previous` to move elements back to previous position. Use None to ignore seafloor.
seafloor_action.title: Seafloor Action

wind_drift_depth.description: The direct wind drift (windage) is linearly decreasing from the surface value (wind_drift_factor) until 0 at this depth.
wind_drift_depth.title: Wind Drift Depth

vertical_mixing_timestep.description: Time step used for inner (fast) loop of the vertical mixing model. Set this smaller to increase frequency of vertical mixing calculation; number of loops is calculated as int(self.time_step/vertical_mixing_timestep) so vertical_mixing_timestep must be smaller than time_step.
vertical_mixing_timestep.title: Vertical Mixing Timestep

wind_drift_factor.description: Elements at surface are moved with this fraction of the wind vector, in addition to currents and Stokes drift.
wind_drift_factor.title: Wind Drift Factor

vertical_mixing.description: Activate vertical mixing scheme. Vertical mixing includes movement due to buoyancy and turbulent mixing.
vertical_mixing.title: Vertical Mixing

title: PublicPhysicsSimulationConfig
